name: logo-to-swiftui-draw
title_zh: PNG 进 SwiftUI Shape 出
tagline_zh: 丢一张几何 logo 图，拿回一个能画轮廓再填色的 SwiftUI 组件。启动页、加载动画、Hero 区直接嵌。
tagline_en: Drop a geometric logo PNG, get a SwiftUI Shape that draws its outline then fills. Splash, loading, hero — drop it.
desc_en: Transforma a imagem (PNG) de um logo num `Shape` do SwiftUI e num componente que desenha o contorno a traço e depois preenche (splash screen, loading, hero). Use quando o usuário disser "desenhar o logo", "animar o logo", "vetorizar o logo", "logo draw", "trace do logo", "splash com o logo desenhando", ou mandar a imagem de um logo pedindo um componente SwiftUI. Cobre logos geométricos (primitivas
why_zh: 自动把位图转成矢量 Shape，并生成描边→填色的时序动画。省掉逐点抠路径的苦工。
why_en: Auto-traces bitmap into a vector Shape and emits the stroke-then-fill timeline. Kills the manual path-point grind for geometric.
limit_zh: 只认几何图形 logo（圆、方、三角等基本图元）；复杂渐变、照片级或带文字的 logo 会失真。
limit_en: Geometric logos only (circles, squares, triangles). Gradients, photos, or text-heavy marks will distort. Output is SwiftUI code, not image/video.
title_en: PNG logo to SwiftUI Shape with stroke-then-fill animation
